d: Gym Heroes is the sixth official expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game, released in North America in August 2000 by Wizards of the Coast. Featuring 132 cards, this landmark set introduced "Owner's Pokémon" alongside the first four Kanto Gym Leaders—Brock, Misty, Lt. Surge, and Erika—as well as the game's very first Stadium cards. Recognizable by its amphitheater set symbol, it features fan-favorite holos like Rocket's Scyther, Blaine's Moltres, and Erika's Dragonair.
